metadata.title: Help & bug reports — Nebula
metadata.description: Find a fix, look up an error or send a report with the details that matter.

page.paragraph_2: Find a fix, look up an error or send a report with the details that matter.

troubleshooting.placeholder_1: Try controller, ray tracing or saves
troubleshooting.paragraph_1: No matching topics. Try another word or report the problem below.
troubleshooting.paragraph_2: Check the region and revision. v2 currently requires the North American RMGE01 revision 0 release. Modified or patched game images may fail the check.
troubleshooting.paragraph_3: Lower internal resolution, ray tracing quality or the interpolation target. Try DLSS / FSR 3 and turn off ambient occlusion.
troubleshooting.paragraph_5: Reconnect the controller, check Controls → Input and select Auto. Some devices need a specific connection or driver.
troubleshooting.question_4: DLSS or ray tracing is missing
troubleshooting.paragraph_7: DLSS needs an NVIDIA RTX GPU and a first-use download followed by a restart. Ray tracing needs DXR 1.1 and Shader Model 6.6 on Windows. Check the in-game System page.
troubleshooting.paragraph_8: Disable mods and try again. Re-enable them one at a time, checking region and priority.
troubleshooting.paragraph_10: Update your graphics driver. On a PC with two GPUs, choose the other GPU in the launcher. If an error code appears, look it up below before changing files.
troubleshooting.paragraph_11: 4K replacement movies need hardware video decoding. Try a lower-resolution replacement or disable that movie pack.
troubleshooting.paragraph_12: Close programs using a lot of CPU time and try again. Include your hardware and background programs if the issue continues.
troubleshooting.paragraph_13: Close the game and check your dated save-backup folders. Import through the launcher rather than overwriting files.
troubleshooting.question_10: Windows or antivirus warns about a download
troubleshooting.paragraph_15: Use only the official release files. Read the release notes for signing and antivirus information. If a warning appears, ask in Discord before running the file.

error-codes.paragraph_1: v2 shows a code when the game stops and saves a report. The error-code guide explains what to try for each code.

report.paragraph_1: Search existing issues first. If the problem is new, include the steps that make it happen and what you expected to see.
report.item_1: Nebula version and whether it is v1 or v2.
report.item_2: Windows version, CPU, GPU and graphics driver.
report.item_3: Galaxy and mission, plus the exact steps to reproduce the problem.
report.item_4: Graphics settings you changed and all enabled mods.
report.item_5: A screenshot or video for visual problems.
report.paragraph_2: For a v2 crash, attach the newest .txt report and, if requested, the .dmp file from
report.paragraph_3: . Review files before sharing. Reports stay on your computer until you attach them.
report.paragraph_4: For a v2 visual or timing issue, open the launcher → Advanced → Recording (next launch) → Lightweight. Play until the problem happens, quit, then attach the ZIP from the folder Nebula opens. Use Detailed recording if asked. In v1, use Advanced → Open diagnostics for available crash logs.
